report:
## Summary
Nightly 2026-10-12 (04b1932) had 5 snapshot-related failures, all in 150-networkD3-sankey on macOS (R 4.2-4.6), caused by a tiny text-rendering shift in the navbar title. I accepted those snapshots plus the regenerated sysinfo files. The other 77 failures are `sp_2.2-3` download/install errors on every OS, with no snapshot content.

## Minute Changes Accepted
- `150-networkD3-sankey` mac-4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 4.5, 4.6 `mytest/002.png` and `004.png`: the only visible difference is a slight glyph/kerning shift in the "networkD3 tests" navbar title. The chart, sidebar and bookmark modal are identical. The convolution values (29.95 and 10.44 against a threshold of 2) are high because the changed pixels are concentrated in the text, not because the layout changed. The new screenshots are about 400 bytes smaller and the same for every R version.
- `inst/apps/sysinfo-{linux,mac,win}-{4.2..4.6}.txt`: generated metadata churn (Chrome 154 to 155, gha_image bump, date, package version and date updates).

## Needs Human Review
None from the snapshot diffs.

Not snapshot issues, but still open: `063-superzip-example`, `156-subapps`, `178-delayed-widget`, `179-nondelayed-widget`, `180-delayed-staticwidget`, `304-bslib-card` and `317-nav-insert` fail with `can_not_install` on all platforms and R versions. `pak` could not download `sp_2.2-3` from packagemanager.posit.co. This is a CI/package-source problem (probably a bad or missing `sp` 2.2-3 binary or source on Posit Package Manager), and no snapshots were touched. Windows 4.2-4.4, macOS 4.6 and some other combinations also had no failing entries for these apps, so the install failures vary by matrix cell.

## Commands Run
- `Rscript -e 'requireNamespace("shinycoreci"/"pak")'`: passed, both already installed.
- `Rscript -e 'shinycoreci::fix_snaps(sha = "04b1932", ask_apps = FALSE, ask_branches = FALSE, ask_if_not_main = FALSE)'`: passed. It applied the patches and updated the 150-networkD3-sankey snapshots and the sysinfo files.
- `git diff --stat -- inst/apps`, `git diff -- inst/apps/sysinfo-*.txt`, and viewing the old and new 002.png and 004.png for 150-networkD3-sankey (mac-4.4): passed. Nothing needed reverting.
- Removed the stray `Rplots.pdf` generated by the helper.
